headline: Trailer: microbial bioinformatics, software and guests
description: Meet hosts Lee Katz, Andrew Page and Nabil-Fareed Alikhan, and hear plans for conversations about microbial bioinformatics.
summary: Lee Katz introduces Micro Binfie and co-hosts Nabil-Fareed Alikhan and Andrew Page. The trailer explains the name and previews conversations about bacterial genotyping history, writing better software and what not to write, alongside guest appearances.

sections.heading: What Micro Binfie means
sections.body: Lee Katz explains that micro and binfie are shorthand for microbial and bioinformatics. He introduces the show as a place for conversations about microbial bioinformatics.

sections.heading: Planned topics and guests
sections.body: The hosts promise the history of bacterial genotyping, how to write better software and what not to write. A brief guest clip includes a comment that having a paper does not mean much if nobody has cited it.

sections.heading: Where to listen
sections.body: The trailer closes with an invitation to subscribe. The show notes list SoundCloud, iTunes and Spotify, as well as listeners’ preferred podcast software.
